details: This package is a controlled-package test artifact. It ships package/backend-canary.js, which computes the SHA-256 hash of the machine hostname (read from /etc/hostname) and the SHA-256 hash of the current OS username, sends them as the host and user query parameters in an HTTPS GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle, and ignores any error. No credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are collected or transmitted; only the two hashed host-metadata values. The package describes itself as "controlled npm backend ingestion" and includes the marker files marker.txt (containing an NPM_BACKEND_PAX_LONGNAME_ test identifier) and a deliberately long-named pax-*-marker.txt, along with index.js exporting the string 'controlled'.
